# autoenv

Template-based config file generation with deterministic per-worktree port allocation. Manages isolated development environments for worktree-based coding agents.

## Build & Test

After any code change:

```bash
cd auto-env && go build ./...
cd auto-env && go test ./...
```

The merged `auto` binary is built from the repo root with `make build` (the env tool ships as `auto env`).
